subject.title: [Bug]: Dashboard/agent fake tool calls with dmxapi model; native claude route returns incomplete terminal response

question: What should OpenClaw do by default when Dashboard or local-model turns emit tool-call-shaped assistant text instead of structured toolCall/toolUse content, while provider routes like dmxapi/native Claude may also be failing independently?
rationale: Current source intentionally combines warning-only diagnostics, bounded text promotion, and documentation that treats unstructured tool-looking text as provider/model incompatibility; changing that default affects security, compatibility, and provider routing.

options.title: Define bounded enforcement
options.body: Choose a supported warning, suppression, retry, promotion, or fail-closed contract and then fix this issue plus the canonical fake-tool policy thread against that contract.

options.title: Keep compatibility default
options.body: Document warning-only handling as the default and limit this issue to live provider-route diagnostics for dmxapi and native Claude failures.

options.title: Split provider investigation
options.body: Move fake-tool default behavior to the canonical issue and keep this issue only for the Windows Dashboard dmxapi/native Claude incomplete-response reproduction.

recommendation.title: Define bounded enforcement
recommendation.body: Choose a supported warning, suppression, retry, promotion, or fail-closed contract and then fix this issue plus the canonical fake-tool policy thread against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from recent source history and the affected core agent-runtime policy surface.
